"Galway Girl" is a song by English singer-songwriter Ed Sheeran.
The song is a collaboration between Sheeran and Irish folk band Beoga, and is heavily influenced by Irish traditional music.
On Saint Patrick's Day, 17 March 2017, Sheeran announced the song as the third single from his 2017 album ÷, accompanied by a lyric video.
